description: Fraunhofer describes a commissioned European gas-security study using MYNTS flow modelling. It examines the loss of Russian imports, alternative supply routes and infrastructure bottlenecks alongside demand reductions. The provider is Fraunhofer IEG; Fraunhofer SCAI; TU Berlin. Coverage: The July 2022 report concerns Europe and compares winter conditions with scenarios through 2025. The announcement does not establish model resolution or the full input period. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The announcement reports model scenarios and estimates, not observed shortages or independently verified forecasts. Full assumptions and results were not reproduced. For simulation it offers a documented gas-security scenario application and an example of separating supply availability from transport capacity. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
